# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report them privately using GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
(the **Security** tab of this repository), or contact the maintainer directly.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact.
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept.
- Any suggested remediation, if known.

You can expect an initial response within a few business days. We ask that you
give us a reasonable amount of time to address the issue before any public
disclosure.

## Supported versions

Unless stated otherwise, only the latest release on the default branch receives
security updates.
